description: Credit-free diagnosis of the first amplified 16-point Grover-Rudolph circuit after hardware k=1 deviated strongly from the ideal model.
stopping_rules: Do not repeat k=1 unless the audit identifies a candidate with lower depth/two-qubit count and acceptable noisy deviation.
Do not submit k=2 until k=1 is stabilized.
If all noisy predictions remain far below the hardware error, treat the issue as an amplified hardware sensitivity not captured by the backend noise model.
